In the following, we report the optimal solution values, if available, or the best lower bounds, as well as the best upper bounds for data set TBED1 in Guastaroba G. and Speranza M.G. A Heuristic for BILP Problems: The Single Source Capacitated Facility Location Problem, currently under review in the European Journal of Operational Research.

The following table is written in LaTex-like language. The first column (Name) shows the name of the instance; the second and the third columns give the number of potential facility locations (|J|) and the number of customers (|I|), respectively. For each instance, column $z^{LB}/z^*$ gives the best Lower Bound or the optimal solution value (optimal solution values are denoted with the symbol (*)). Column 'Best UB' shows the best Upper Bound found by any of the approaches compared in the paper mentioned above.
